## Agency OS · Setup
Run this **once**. It creates the *Agency DB* Google Sheet with every tab and header row the other workflows expect.

1. Connect a Google Sheets OAuth2 credential on both HTTP nodes.
2. Click **Execute workflow**.
3. Copy `spreadsheet_id` from the last node into the **Config** node of every other workflow (`sheet_id`).
